validation.evidence: M131/mode_1 is a single-ST legacy LockReSpin base game. Re-derived with parse_rounds over the real chunk (rawdata/M131/mode_1/chunk_0001.json, 40,000 rounds): SpinType tally {13:40000} (genuinely single ST, no ST14/ST15 TopDollar). CostCredits==0 on 100% of rounds while BetAmount==1000 on 100% — the legacy LockReSpin shape (M10/M23/M131/M133). The frozen parser short-circuits these to PAID via cost_credits_unreliable (parser.py L651-666 detect all-zero-cost+any-positive-bet; L1668-1670 names M131 explicitly and forces is_paid=True), so every round is its own paid reel spin. SpinTimes increments +1 per round (1,2,3,...; verified monotonic) => no SpinTimes-grouping / no in-line free continuation. The lines-lock feature fires INLINE within the same paid ST13: ReMarks=='trigger' on 4,754/40,000 rounds (11.9%) exactly when LockLines is populated (e.g. '1-2-','1-','1-3-'), 100% overlap (lock rounds == trigger rounds == 4754); the parser recognizes+accumulates LockLines (parser.py L1591) -> lock_lines_spins=4754, lock_lines_total_lines=5275. NO separate respin/freespin/settlement/wheel ST. Play name 'LockReSpin' verified from the server analysisResult FeatureWin taxonomy (SINGLE key 'LockReSpin'; TotalWin SpinType 'Normal') and reproduced by the parser's upstream_feature_tally (single 'LockReSpin' key) — NOT invented. Conservation: PayoutIdToWinAmount sums EXACTLY to WinCredits on all 6,470/6,470 winning rounds (0 mismatch); aggregate sum(WinCredits)=34,283,000 == sum(payid)=34,283,000; parse_chunk_response gives spin_type_win[13]=34,283,000 == sum(payout_id_win_by_spin_type)=34,283,000 with ZERO fallback/_unattributed bucket. Collect audit: ABORT3 residual (WinCredits>0 AND payid present AND sum(payid)<WinCredits) = 0; CurJackpotStoreWin=0 on 100% (established test-interface-zeroed fleet pattern), no AccCredits/CollectCount fields => no live collect-coin. ABORT1 paid-win-with-no-payid=0; ABORT4 IndexToWheelCellData=0. Field signature is byte-identical to validated precedent M23 ST13 (paid_spin/LockReSpin), and M131 is named in M23's own manifest note as part of the M10/M23/M131/M133 group. paid_session_count=40000, paid_bet=40,000,000 (non-zero denominator), base RTP=85.71% (value-agnostic, not pinned). 3-layer audit PASS: (a) signature match to M23 ST13; (b) parser code reads (M131 named L645/L1668, LockLines L1591); (c) parse_chunk_response run on real data with correct semantic output. STRICT-REUSE: manifest-only onboard, mirroring M23.json shape; NO new code, NO synth pay-id rule, NO round_win_rule.
caveats: Despite role being labelled paid_spin (matching the M23 precedent, not hold_respin), the win taxonomy is entirely 'LockReSpin' — the base game IS the lock-respin feature, paid via natural PayoutIdToWinAmount. This is the M23/M10/M133 archetype, distinct from M227/M277/M201-style machines where ST13 hold_respin is a free CostCredits=0 event granted off a SEPARATE paid base ST (ST140); M131 has no separate base ST.

CostCredits is 0 on 100% of rounds; the pre-scan's paid_frac:1 reflects BetAmount>0, not CostCredits. Paid classification relies entirely on the frozen parser's cost_credits_unreliable short-circuit (parser.py), which is a load-bearing precondition for this onboard. If that short-circuit were ever removed/altered, M131 would silently reclassify all 40,000 rounds as bonus and zero the paid denominator — but it is frozen and explicitly names M131.

CurJackpotStoreWin present on every round but =0 (test-interface-zeroed fleet pattern, declaration-confirmed per gate-8 ruling); parse as-is at 0, no progressive jackpot win visible in current testspin interface.
Money-agnostic: base RTP ~85.71% observed is descriptive only and must NOT be pinned/validated against a target.

Only mode_1 was audited (the onboarding scope). mode_2/5/7 chunks exist on disk but were not inspected; if onboarded later they should be re-scanned for signature drift (e.g. skin/feature changes by mode).
